ownershipInvariants: No two assigned workstreams may share an exclusiveOwn glob that can match the same path.
Production files outside exclusiveOwn are either consumeReadOnly, extendViaNewSiblingOnly, or forbidden.
Integration conflicts are resolved by publishing adapters/mocks, not by rewriting another workstream's contract.
NS-4 store work remains a separate authorized track under docs/architecture/NS-4-*; this fleet does not absorb or reopen it.
WS-EHB must coordinate with WS-CKF interfaces; it must not invent a second EDGAR downloader or source registry.
